title: Best Time to Visit Siam Park: Weather, Crowds & Queue Tips
metaTitle: Best Time to Visit Siam Park (2026 Guide: Avoid Crowds & Queues)
metaDescription: Discover the best time of day and month to visit Siam Park. Expert tips on avoiding crowds, queues at Tower of Power, and getting the most rides in.
excerpt: Opening vs. midday, best months for shorter queues at Tower of Power, and why arriving right at opening completely changes your day.
quickAnswer: Arrive right at 10:00 AM opening time and head straight for Tower of Power. You'll get short or no queues on the park's most popular slide before the crowds build up around midday.
imageAlt: Sunlight over a water park slide tower in the early morning

content.text: Siam Park is consistently ranked among the world's best water parks, which means it can also get busy — especially in peak summer season. The timing of your visit makes a real difference to how many rides you can fit in.
The Golden Rule: Opening Rush vs. Midday Crowds

Siam Park opens at 10:00 AM daily. Guests who arrive right at opening and head straight for Tower of Power or Wave Palace get noticeably shorter queues than those who arrive after 11:30 AM, once coach groups and later arrivals fill the park.
Best Months of the Year to Visit

Tenerife's climate is mild year-round, but Siam Park is busiest in July and August, and around Spanish and UK school holiday weeks. Late spring (May–June) and early autumn (September–October) offer warm weather with noticeably thinner crowds.
Weekday vs. Weekend
Weekdays outside school holidays are consistently quieter than weekends, when local visitors join the usual tourist crowd. If your schedule is flexible, a Tuesday or Wednesday visit is a good bet.
Summary & Recommendations

To get the most out of your visit, book online in advance, arrive right at 10:00 AM, and hit the park's most popular slides — Tower of Power and Wave Palace — first, before working your way to the more relaxed Mai Thai River later in the day.

title: General Admission vs. All-Inclusive: Which Siam Park Ticket Should You Book?
metaTitle: Siam Park General Admission vs All-Inclusive: Honest Comparison (2026)
metaDescription: Comparing Siam Park's General Admission ticket vs the All-Inclusive ticket: cost breakdown, what's included, and which is worth it.
excerpt: A transparent comparison between Siam Park's standard General Admission ticket and the All-Inclusive ticket with Fast Track, food and drinks.
quickAnswer: If you're visiting on a quieter day or don't mind occasional queues, General Admission is the better value. If you're visiting in peak season or want to maximize ride time, the All-Inclusive ticket's Fast Track pass usually pays for itself.
imageAlt: A tropical water slide tower at a Thai-inspired water park
ctaHeading: Ready to book your Siam Park ticket?
ctaBody: Compare General Admission, the All-Inclusive ticket, and the Loro Parque Twin Ticket.

content.text: When booking your Siam Park visit, one of the first decisions is whether to go with the standard General Admission ticket or upgrade to the All-Inclusive ticket.
Why the All-Inclusive Ticket Wins in Peak Season

The All-Inclusive ticket bundles a Fast Track pass — one priority ride per participating slide — with lunch, drinks, a towel and a locker. In July and August, when queues at Tower of Power and Wave Palace can run long, Fast Track alone can save you well over an hour of standing in line.
When General Admission Makes More Sense

On a quieter weekday, in shoulder season, or if you're happy to bring your own towel and buy food as you go, General Admission covers everything you actually need — full-day access to every ride — at the lowest price.
The Verdict

Book the All-Inclusive ticket if you're visiting in peak season or want a stress-free day with lunch, drinks and Fast Track sorted in advance. Book General Admission if you're visiting off-peak or prefer to keep things simple and pay as you go.

content.text: Getting to Siam Park

Siam Park sits right in Costa Adeje on Tenerife's south coast. Many hotels in Costa Adeje are within easy walking distance or a short free shuttle ride, while a free Siam Park shuttle bus also serves hotels in Los Cristianos and Las Américas. Elsewhere on the island, public TITSA buses and taxis serve the park directly, and paid parking is available on-site.
Opening Hours by Season

In summer season (May 1 to October 29), Siam Park is open 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM daily. In winter season (October 30 to April 30), it's open 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM daily. The park is closed on December 25 and January 1, and last entry is typically 1 hour before closing.
Essential Packing Checklist

items: Swimwear (worn under your clothes saves a locker trip)
Reef-safe sunscreen and a hat or rash vest for sun protection
A towel, unless your ticket already includes one
A dry bag or waterproof phone pouch for the wave and river rides
A change of clothes for the journey home

content.text: Make the Most of Your Day

Arrive right at opening, hit the headline slides first, and take a relaxed float down Mai Thai River once the midday crowds build up. If you're staying in Tenerife for more than a day, pair your visit with a trip to Loro Parque using the Twin Ticket.
